Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1388
Claimant:
Jeff Hoffman
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
3-9-25
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection. The claimant reports a wrist fracture and is handling
the claim without a lawyer. Assigned for initial review.
4-20-25
Confirmed the claimant is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with
coverage start have come up.
4-22-25
Spoke with the claimant, who described the collision the same way as in the first notice. The account has stayed
consistent arcoss every conversation so far.
5-5-25
Police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. The other
driver's statement matches the claimant's description of how the crash happened.
6-6-25
Scene photographs were reviewed. The damage pattern is largely consistent with the side impact described and with
the speeds involved.
6-12-25
No prior damage to the vehicle appears in our records or in the photos taken at inspection. Repair estimate requested
from the shop.
8-8-25
The reported wrist fracture fits the kind of force expected from a side impact of this type. Medical records were
requested from the treating provider.
8-10-25
Medical records show no earlier injury to the wrist or nearby body areas. Prior claims search returned nothing
relevant.
8-21-25
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested an updated treatment plan and a
note from the treating physician explaining the timeline.
9-8-25
Physician's update received and reviewed. The timeline is within a reasonable range given the fracture type. Claim
remians open pending final repair estimate and the physician's full report.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
